The following events took place in '''149 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Bakur Mining Corporation]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonizes]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', which is set during the events of ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'' and therefore in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', dates the [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] by the [[Bakur Mining Corporation]] to 153 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to its setting.</ref>
